name: Transaction Certificate Contract 2
definition: Certificate and contract reference of a transaction.

ContractReference.name: Contract Reference
ContractReference.definition: Reference of the contract provided as through the date and identification of the contract or through the registered contract identification.

TransactionAmountInContractCurrency.name: Transaction Amount In Contract Currency
TransactionAmountInContractCurrency.definition: Provides the amount of the transaction in the currency of the registered contract.

ExpectedShipmentDate.name: Expected Shipment Date
ExpectedShipmentDate.definition: Expected shipment date as per registered contract.

ExpectedAdvancePaymentReturnDate.name: Expected Advance Payment Return Date
ExpectedAdvancePaymentReturnDate.definition: Expected advance payment (or prepayment) return date in case counterparty will not deliver the goods/services.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Further details on the transaction certificate contract.

TransactionAmountInContractCurrencyPrese.definition: If ContractReference/RegisteredContractIdentification is absent then TransactionAmountInContractCurrency must be absent.
